assets.alt: 木漏れ日の小道と池を、親子が巡る自然観察のイラスト
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original commissioned editorial gouache illustration for a Japanese family nature-observation event website. Sophisticated, warm, airy, poetic, friendly to both adults and children. Matte cut-paper-inspired shapes with hand-painted gouache irregularities, very subtle risograph print grain and cream paper fibers. Palette: warm ivory #F7F3E8, deep forest green #163F32, muted jade #7EAA87, pale sage #D5E1C5, sunshine yellow #F5CD55, tiny burnt-orange #DA793F accents. Restrained flat perspective with layered depth, elegant negative space, confident compositions. Nature should look inviting and full of small discoveries. No lettering, no text, no numbers, no watermarks, no logos, no frames around the entire artwork, no glossy 3D, no generic vector clipart, no kawaii faces on objects, no portrait or recognizable real person, no official mascot. This is a conceptual artwork, not a factual geographical map.
Asset type: wide website hero, landscape aspect ratio 16:9. Main scene: a picturesque Japanese lowland insect-observation park, a sandy winding woodland path leading into a sunlit grove, lush deciduous trees with broad green leaves, small still pond and reeds to one side, open warm-ivory sky between tree canopies. A brilliant yellow butterfly flying near the foreground, a small beetle resting on a foreground leaf. Just two tiny visitors seen from behind, an adult and child in simple outdoor clothes looking together at a leaf along the path, anonymous and very small in the landscape, no face details. No mountain drama or landmark architecture. Compose as an expansive beautifully illustrated landscape, with the winding trail inviting the viewer into the scene. Keep the central band readable and not cluttered; use rich darker green foreground leaves to frame a bright airy center. The scene should feel like a discovery waiting a few steps away. All people fully clothed. No text.

productionDerivative.packaging: Sharp resize and WebP encoding; no creative alteration
